calculate_instance_root_kpt_center: calculate instance root coordinates using the mean of visible keypoints with kpt_center root type
calculate_instance_root_bbox_center: calculate instance root coordinates as the center of bounding boxes outlined by visible keypoints
calculate_pseudo_bbox_from_keypoints: calculate pseudo instance bounding boxes in xyxy format from visible keypoints for pose estimation
calculate_diagonal_lengths_from_keypoint: calculate the diagonal length of instance bounding boxes from visible keypoints for pose normalization
get_instance_root_with_visibility: calculate instance root coordinates and visibility flags from keypoints with optional visibility mask
